metadata.title: Retro Pop Portrait with Plastic Distortion

retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait viewed through a distorted, reflective plastic or glass surface with hands pressed against the barrier.
triggerTerms: soft glow portrait with script header

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a subject positioned behind a translucent, wrinkled material that creates cyan-tinted light refractions and distortions. The subject's hands are splayed and pressed against the surface, creating a sense of depth and physical interaction with the frame's boundary.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between two splayed hands
Refractive light streaks radiating from the corners
Script typography anchored to the top edge
Dark, moody background contrasting with warm skin tones
coreInvariants: Translucent plastic-like distortion layer over the entire image
Hands pressed flat against the viewing plane
Soft-focus lighting on the central face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, head and shoulders, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the two splayed hands forming a triangular focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top script text down to the face, then outward to the hands and the light refractions.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the lower corners and around the subject's torso.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and teal light refractions through the plastic surface.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and tan skin tones with cream-colored typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value highlights on the hands and face.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected strokes with varying thickness
Brush-like terminals with a slight texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 's' has a distinct sharp top curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone script for a signature look.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the brush-stroke energy and retro feel.
Matches the casual, connected 70s pop aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person behind a wrinkled, reflective plastic sheet with their hands pressed against it, featuring cyan light refractions.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a cream-colored, hand-drawn cursive script across the top margin.

verificationChecks: Is the plastic distortion visible over the face?
Are the hands pressed flat against the frame?
Is the text in a fluid script style at the top?

mustAchieve: Tactile sense of the plastic barrier

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic hand-to-surface contact shadows
Ensure script text does not obscure the eyes
Verify the cyan tint is localized to the plastic highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Plastic Overlay + Pressed Hands + Top Script = Retro Pop Aesthetic
